_doc: Reviewed input for Palakkad's District Environment Plan, posted on palakkad.nic.in on 17/07/2020 as 'District Environment Plan ( PDF 523 KB )'. The PDF is the CPCB model plan's Excel workbook printed to 14 pages: one row per data item, a district column ('Please enter Measurable Outcome for Palakkad District') and one column per urban local body. Page 1 states the district column covers 'WHOLE DISTRICT INCLUDING 88 PANCHAYATHS AND 7 ULBS EXCEPT FOR SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT PLAN AND PLASTIC WASTE MANAGEMENT PLAN'. Figures are the district column's water rows (water-quality inventory, groundwater, domestic sewage, industrial waste water); ULB columns are not transcribed. The plan carries no demand, supply or deficit water balance, so waterBalance stays null, and it has no narrative action points. Where the plan's own cells disagree the disagreement is recorded in document.quirks and the figure's detail, never corrected. Two readings on 2026-09-29: the PDF layout text layer (every quote is a whitespace-normalised substring of its page's pdftotext -layout text: the printed row line holding the row code and the district value) and the page images at 200 dpi (every value re-read, 12 of 12 agree). Producer: scripts/atlas-environment-plan-district.ts --district palakkad --as-of <date>.

document.title: District Enviromental Plan - Palakkad District
document.editionNote: The workbook prints no date and no signature block; the date is the PDF's creation date, 16 July 2020, which matches the 2020/07 upload path and the listing's posting date of 17/07/2020. The title is transcribed as printed ('ENVIROMENTAL').
document.template: The CPCB model District Environment Plan as its Excel data workbook (Details of Data Requirement / Units of Measurable Outcome / a district column / one column per ULB) for waste, water quality, domestic sewage, industrial waste water, air, mining and noise, printed to PDF without the narrative district profile or gap-and-action tables, and without naming the NGT order in its text.
quirks: The print carries no page numbers, so printedPage repeats the viewer's page.

WQ1e, 'Total Quantity of sewage and industrial discharge in District [Automatic] (SW1a+IW1b)', prints 12.28 MLD. SW1a on PDF page 1 is total solid waste, 60.6 MT/Day, so the cell is not that sum; 12.28 equals the 10 printed in SM1g plus the 2.28 MLD of IWW1b (our arithmetic), while SM1a prints 3 MLD of sewage generated. 12.28 is not transcribed.

SM1g, 'Quantity of untreated or partially treated sewage [Automatic]', prints 10 with no unit, and WQ5a, 'Percentage of untreated sewage [%] (automatic SM1g/SM1a)', prints 10, while SM1a is 3 MLD (10 of 3 would be over 300 percent). Neither is transcribed.
WQ1d prints '9639 and 24 Hectares' for lakes and ponds: 24 hectares across 9,639 water bodies is under 25 square metres each, so only the count is transcribed.
WQ2a, 'Estimated number of bore-wells', and WQ2b, 'No of permissions given for extraction of groundwater', both print 11082 in the district column. Both are transcribed as printed.

Free-standing cells in the PALAKKAAD ULB column ('28000 litres per day' beside WQ1e, '20000 litres per day' beside SM1a, '5000 litre per day' beside IWW1b) belong to that ULB's column, not the district's, and are not transcribed.
